detail.longDescription:
Previously, I would always use the #Docker setup with #Coolify.

1. GH Action would build the Docker image
2. GH Action would call a Coolify webhook
3. Coolify would pull the built Docker image
4. Entry point script would run migrations, start a worker in the background, then start gunicorn

I totally skipped over using Docker Compose which solves a bunch of this nicely.

- web is now dependent on migrations
- worker services with independent logging

Way better!
